- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
Support `use_gigatoken=True` while maintaining HF parity (with fallback on a fixed set of unicode characters). The default path remains `use_gigatoken=False`, this change requires user to explicitly opt in via use_gigatoken=True` or the `--use-gigatoken` flag. The tokenization encoding time is 10x - 40x faster depending on input. The functional support is achieved through:
1. Support right-aligned numeric grouping [Gigatoken PR](https://github.com/jupiterepoch/gigatoken/pull/1/changes). The current Gigatoken supports NT3, where a number string "12345" is broken into "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", whereas NT4 would break it into "12", "345".
2. Wire gigatoken into Megatron-LM
3. Fall-back to HF when Gigatoken process unicode characters differently. Gigatoken's ICU 2.2 Unicode 17 character classes differ from HF tokenizers 0.22's Unicode 16 regex. A compiled guard covers the 28 affected ranges and routes the entire input or batch through HF to preserve token boundaries. ASCII skips the regex; compatible Unicode uses Gigatoken. The guard also checks characters introduced by rendered chat templates. Direct native encoding and bulk `encode_files` bypass this guard.

### Validation

Validated with end2end run, with transformers 5.15.1 and tokenizers 0.22.2:

- All **38 new tokenizer tests** and **283 existing serving tests** passed. Tests are added to the existing tokenizer test file.
- Local parity checks against a complete HF tokenizer configuration covered all **1,112,064 valid Unicode scalars** in contextual inputs, in both normal and ordinary-text encoding modes: zero ID or round-trip differences.
- Public HTTP handlers with the real tokenizer configuration and a canned inference client passed prompt-ID and response comparisons, native/fallback routing, template-introduced Unicode, tokenizer copying and **16 concurrent requests**. 

### Setup for right-aligned tokenizer configurations

Install the required fork into the same Python environment used by the serving/RL processes, including the container used on worker nodes. After the normal Megatron environment and Gigatoken dependencies are installed, replace only Gigatoken with the tested revision:

```bash
python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps \
  "gigatoken @ git+https://github.com/jupiterepoch/gigatoken.git@522b4fadabd2a6d475fc355b0b4b54ee691c24f2"
```

This source build requires Git and the Rust nightly toolchain specified by the fork's `rust-toolchain.toml`. Verify the loaded module and recorded source revision:

```bash
python - <<'PYTHON'
import gigatoken as gt
from importlib.metadata import distribution

print(gt.__file__)
print(distribution("gigatoken").read_text("direct_url.json"))
PYTHON
```

The recorded repository should be `https://github.com/jupiterepoch/gigatoken.git` and `vcs_info.commit_id` should be `522b4fadabd2a6d475fc355b0b4b54ee691c24f2`.  

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [x] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ x I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

+if HAVE_TRANSFORMERS:
+
+    class _GigatokenTokenizer(PreTrainedTokenizerFast):
+        """Keep HF rendering, metadata and decoding while accelerating text encoding."""
+
+        # Gigatoken's ICU 2.2 uses Unicode 17; HF tokenizers 0.22 uses Unicode 16.
+        # These ranges cover all differences in letter case, marks, numbers and whitespace.
+        _unicode_fallback_re = re.compile(
+            r'[\u0295\u088f\u0c5c\u0cdc\u1acf-\u1add\u1ae0-\u1aeb\ua7ce-\ua7cf\ua7d2\ua7d4'
+            r'\ua7f1\U00010940-\U00010959\U00010ec5-\U00010ec7\U00010efa-\U00010efb'
+            r'\U00011b60-\U00011b67\U00011db0-\U00011ddb\U00011de0-\U00011de9'
+            r'\U00016ea0-\U00016eb8\U00016ebb-\U00016ed3\U00016ff2-\U00016ff6'
+            r'\U000187f8-\U000187ff\U00018d09-\U00018d1e\U00018d80-\U00018df2'
+            r'\U0001e6c0-\U0001e6de\U0001e6e0-\U0001e6f5\U0001e6fe-\U0001e6ff'
+            r'\U0002b73a-\U0002b73f\U0002cea2-\U0002cead\U000323b0-\U00033479]'
+        )
+
+        def __init__(self, tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerFast) -> None:
+            from megatron.core.tokenizers.utils import init_gigatoken_from_hf
+
+            # Preserve the loaded HF configuration and native decoder for DecodeStream.
+            self.__dict__.update(tokenizer.__dict__)
+            self._hf_tokenizer = tokenizer
+            self._gigatoken = init_gigatoken_from_hf(tokenizer, tokenizer.name_or_path)
+            self.tokenizer = self._gigatoken.tokenizer
+
+        def __reduce__(
+            self,
+        ) -> tuple[
+            Callable[..., "_GigatokenTokenizer"], tuple[PreTrainedTokenizerFast], dict[str, Any]
+        ]:
+            # Spawned serving workers rebuild native encoders from the retained HF tokenizer.
+            state = self.__dict__.copy()
+            for name in ('tokenizer', '_gigatoken', '_split_special_tokenizer'):
+                state.pop(name, None)
+            return type(self), (self._hf_tokenizer,), state
+
+        @cached_property
+        def _split_special_tokenizer(self) -> "HFCompat":
+            import gigatoken as gt
+
+            # Gigatoken's matcher is immutable. Ordinary text needs a separate matcher
+            # without special added tokens; non-special added tokens still match.
+            config = json.loads(self.backend_tokenizer.to_str())
+            config['added_tokens'] = [
+                t for t in config.get('added_tokens', []) if not t.get('special')
+            ]
+            return gt.Tokenizer.from_json(json.dumps(config)).as_hf()
+
+        def __call__(
+            self, text: Any = None, text_pair: Any = None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any
+        ) -> BatchEncoding:
+            supported = {
+                'add_special_tokens',
+                'split_special_tokens',
+                'return_attention_mask',
+                'return_tensors',
+                'padding',
+                'truncation',
+                'max_length',
+            }
+            if (
+                args
+                or text_pair is not None
+                or not (
+                    isinstance(text, str)
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(text, (list, tuple))
+                        and text
+                        and all(isinstance(t, str) for t in text)
+                    )
+                )
+                or kwargs.keys() - supported
+                or kwargs.get('padding')
+                or kwargs.get('truncation')
+                or kwargs.get('max_length') is not None
+                or set(self.model_input_names) - {'input_ids', 'attention_mask'}
+            ):
+                return super().__call__(text, text_pair, *args, **kwargs)
+
+            # Keep ASCII cheap; fall back for the whole input to preserve BPE boundaries.
+            texts = (text,) if isinstance(text, str) else text
+            if any(not t.isascii() and self._unicode_fallback_re.search(t) for t in texts):
+                return super().__call__(text, text_pair, *args, **kwargs)
+
+            tokenizer = (
+                self._split_special_tokenizer
+                if kwargs.get('split_special_tokens', self.split_special_tokens)
+                else self._gigatoken
+            )
+            encoded = tokenizer(
+                text,
+                add_special_tokens=kwargs.get('add_special_tokens', True),
+                return_attention_mask=kwargs.get(
+                    'return_attention_mask', 'attention_mask' in self.model_input_names
+                ),
+            )
+            return BatchEncoding(
+                dict(encoded),
+                tensor_type=kwargs.get('return_tensors'),
+                prepend_batch_axis=isinstance(text, str),
+            )
+
+        def apply_chat_template(
+            self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any
+        ) -> Union[
+            str, List[str], List[int], List[List[int]], BatchEncoding, "Tensor", "NDArray[Any]"
+        ]:
+            """Preserve HF's character-to-token alignment when returning assistant masks."""
+            if kwargs.get('return_assistant_tokens_mask'):
+                # Assistant masks require HF's character-to-token alignment data.
+                return self._hf_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(*args, **kwargs)
+            return super().apply_chat_template(*args, **kwargs)

+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair

+                text = 'x' * offset + f'aa{character}bb 12345{character}6789 <extra><ordinary>'
+                assert native.text_to_ids(text) == hf.text_to_ids(text)
+                assert (

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('split_special_tokens', [False, True])
+def test_gigatoken_unicode_batch_fallback(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer], split_special_tokens: bool
+) -> None:
+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    batch = ['Invoice 1234567 café 中文', '12345\U00011de06789 <extra><ordinary>']
+    name = '_split_special_tokenizer' if split_special_tokens else '_gigatoken'
+    with patch.object(native.tokenizer, name) as encode:
+        for values in (batch, tuple(batch)):
+            kwargs = dict(add_special_tokens=False, split_special_tokens=split_special_tokens)
+            assert native.tokenizer(values, **kwargs) == hf.tokenizer(values, **kwargs)
+        encode.assert_not_called()
+

+def test_gigatoken_unicode_chat_fallback(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer],
+) -> None:
+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    conversation = [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Invoice 1234567'}]
+    # The rendered template can introduce an affected character absent from messages.
+    template = '\U00011de0' + hf.tokenizer.chat_template
+    with patch.object(native.tokenizer, '_gigatoken') as encode:
+        assert native.apply_chat_template(
+            conversation, chat_template=template, return_dict=False
+        ) == hf.apply_chat_template(conversation, chat_template=template, return_dict=False)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('batched', [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('return_dict', [False, True, None])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('tensor_type', [None, 'np', 'pt'])
+def test_gigatoken_chat_template_parity(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer],
+    batched: bool,
+    return_dict: bool | None,
+    tensor_type: str | None,
+) -> None:
+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    conversation: list[Any] = [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Invoice 1234567 <extra> café'}]
+    if batched:
+        conversation = [conversation, [{'role': 'user', 'content': '中文 ١٢٣٤٥٦٧'}]]
+    kwargs = {'tokenize': True, 'add_generation_prompt': True, 'return_tensors': tensor_type}
+    if tensor_type:
+        kwargs['padding'] = True
+    if return_dict is not None:
+        kwargs['return_dict'] = return_dict
+    with patch.object(
+        native.tokenizer.tokenizer, 'encode', wraps=native.tokenizer.tokenizer.encode
+    ) as encode:
+        expected = hf.apply_chat_template(conversation, chat_template=None, **kwargs)
+        actual = native.apply_chat_template(conversation, chat_template=None, **kwargs)
+        if not batched and tensor_type is None:
+            assert encode.call_count > 0
+    if hasattr(expected, 'keys'):
+        assert type(actual) is type(expected)
+        assert actual.keys() == expected.keys()
+        if tensor_type == 'pt':
+            assert actual.to('cpu') is actual
+        for key in expected:
+            if tensor_type:
+                assert actual[key].dtype == expected[key].dtype
+                assert np.array_equal(actual[key], expected[key])
+            else:
+                assert actual[key] == expected[key]
+    elif tensor_type:
+        assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype
+        assert np.array_equal(actual, expected)
+    else:
+        assert actual == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('side', ['left', 'right'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('truncation', [False, True])
+def test_gigatoken_chat_padding_and_truncation(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer],
+    side: str,
+    truncation: bool,

+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    for tokenizer in (hf.tokenizer, native.tokenizer):

+    messages = [[{'role': 'user', 'content': text}] for text in ('hello', 'Invoice 1234567 café')]

+        {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'café 中文'},

+    template = (
+        '{% for m in messages %}{{ m.role }}:'

+        '{% else %}{{ m.content }}{% endif %}<eos>{% endfor %}'

+    cases: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
+        {'tokenize': False},
+        {'tokenize': True, 'return_dict': False, 'continue_final_message': True},
+        {'tokenize': True, 'return_dict': True, 'return_assistant_tokens_mask': True},
+        {
+            'tokenize': True,
+            'return_dict': True,
+            'tokenizer_kwargs': {'return_offsets_mapping': True},
+        },
+    ]
+    for kwargs in cases:
+        assert native.apply_chat_template(
+            conversation, chat_template=template, **kwargs
+        ) == hf.apply_chat_template(conversation, chat_template=template, **kwargs)

+def test_gigatoken_serving_worker_serialization(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer],
+) -> None:
+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    text = 'Invoice 1234567 <extra> café'
+    native.tokenizer(
+        text, add_special_tokens=native.include_special_tokens, split_special_tokens=True
+    ).input_ids  # Populate the ordinary-text cache before transfer.
+    native.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'
+    restored = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(native))
+    assert restored.tokenizer.padding_side == 'left'
+    assert restored.text_to_ids(text) == hf.text_to_ids(text)
+    assert (
+        restored.tokenizer(
+            text, add_special_tokens=restored.include_special_tokens, split_special_tokens=True
+        ).input_ids
+        == hf.tokenizer(
+            text, add_special_tokens=hf.include_special_tokens, split_special_tokens=True
+        ).input_ids
+    )
+    messages = [{'role': 'user', 'content': text}]
+    assert restored.apply_chat_template(
+        messages, chat_template=None, return_dict=False
+    ) == hf.apply_chat_template(messages, chat_template=None, return_dict=False)

+def test_gigatoken_streaming_preserves_hf_interface(
+    gigatoken_hf_pair: tuple[HuggingFaceTokenizer, HuggingFaceTokenizer],
+) -> None:
+    from megatron.core.inference.text_generation_server.dynamic_text_gen_server.incremental_detokenizer import (
+        HuggingFaceFastIncrementalDetokenizer,
+    )
+
+    hf, native = gigatoken_hf_pair
+    original = HuggingFaceFastIncrementalDetokenizer(SimpleNamespace(_tokenizer=hf), [])
+    fast = HuggingFaceFastIncrementalDetokenizer(SimpleNamespace(_tokenizer=native), [])
+    ids = hf.text_to_ids('Invoice 1234567 café 中文 <extra>')
+    for token in ids:
+        assert fast.update([token]) == original.update([token])
+    assert fast.text == original.text
+
+
 # Uses same local path as test_hf_tokenizer; tests EOS stripping vs keeping in detokenized output (e.g. RL).
 LOCAL_HF_TOKENIZER_PATH = "/opt/data/tokenizers/huggingface"
